tasks.name: Review Feature
tasks.description: Review the feature and its associated work items to ensure alignment with business objectives, coordination with team members, and add tasks if necessary.

tasks.name: Review Work Item
tasks.description: Review the work item and all pre-defined tasks to ensure that tasks are aligned with business objectives and add tasks if necessary.

tasks.name: Reproduce Locally
tasks.description: Attempt to reproduce the issue locally to better understand the problem and identify potential solutions.

tasks.name: Review Existing Implementation(s)
tasks.description: Review existing implementations to gather insights and derive potential solutions.

tasks.name: Meet with Feature Leader
tasks.description: Meet with the feature leader to discuss the work item's scope within the grand scheme of the feature.

tasks.name: Meet with Subject Matter Expert
tasks.description: Meet with the noted subject matter expert to discuss the work item's implementation.

tasks.name: Meet with Product Owners
tasks.description: Meet with product owners to clarify requirements and ensure alignment with business objectives.

tasks.name: Meet with Stakeholders
tasks.description: Meet with stakeholders to gather feedback and ensure the work item aligns with their expectations.

tasks.name: Meet with Quality Assurance
tasks.description: Meet with QA to discuss test cases and ensure alignment on quality expectations.

tasks.name: Create Implementation Tasks
tasks.description: After conducting the necessary reviews and meetings, create tasks that represent the steps needed to execute the work item's acceptance criteria (be sure to account for non-functional requirements).

tasks.name: Setup Environment
tasks.description:
Setup the development environment to execute the work item.
- Download repository.
- Run any tests against main.
- Create topic branch.
- Install dependencies.

tasks.name: QA Write Test Cases
tasks.description: Write test cases that are comprehensive and aligned with business objectives.

tasks.name: QA Review Test Cases
tasks.description: Review the test cases to ensure they are correct, comprehensive, and cover all scenarios.

tasks.name: Dev Review Test Cases
tasks.description: Review the test cases to ensure they are correct, comprehensive, and cover all scenarios.

tasks.name: Create Quality Assurance Build
tasks.description: Create a build for QA testing to validate the implementation.

tasks.name: QA Deployment to Test Environment
tasks.description: Deploy the build to the test environment for QA validation.

tasks.name: QA Test Case Execution
tasks.description: Execute the test cases to validate the functionality of the work item.

tasks.name: Support QA Testing
tasks.description: Provide support to the QA team during the testing process.

tasks.name: QA Smoke Testing
tasks.description: Perform smoke testing to validate the stability of the build in the test environment.

tasks.name: Support Smoke Testing
tasks.description: Provide support during smoke testing to address any issues that arise.

tasks.name: Create Draft PR
tasks.description: Create a draft pull request to initiate the code review process.

tasks.name: Self-Review PR
tasks.description: Perform a self-review of the pull request to ensure code quality and completeness.

tasks.name: Publish PR
tasks.description: Publish the pull request for review by other team members.

tasks.name: Resolve PR Feedback
tasks.description: Address feedback provided during the pull request review process.

tasks.name: Run PR Validations
tasks.description: Run automated validations for the pull request to ensure compliance with standards.

tasks.name: Complete PR
tasks.description: Complete the pull request after all validations and reviews are successful.
